title: Universal Evaluative Rule Schema
description: Machine, agent, and human-readable data contract. Completely context-free. Applies to international laws, corporate policies, engineering standards, scientific protocols, and AI governance frameworks.

jurisdiction_scope.description: Abstract labels defining where this schema is law (e.g., EU, Engineering-Dept, Solar-System).

semantic_glossary.description: Global key-value store for terms used across directives.

editorial_ref.description: Reference to the human-readable editorial doctrine.

document.description: URI or filename of the editorial doctrine document.

limits.description: Named thresholds referenced by directives (DRY — single source of truth).

vocabulary.description: Shared word lists and term registries used by directives.

technical_hints.description: Domain-specific technical hints for evaluators. Separated from core params to keep the schema context-free.

file_glob.description: Glob pattern for target files (if evaluating file-based artifacts).

check.description: Path to check script or evaluation protocol.

fix.description: Path to fix script or remediation protocol.

directives.description: Directive definitions — specific obligations and flexible standards.

directive.description: A single directive — either a specific obligation or a flexible standard.

id.description: Stable directive ID. Prefix matches jurisdiction or domain, e.g. XX-001, XX-002.

kind.description: The nature of this directive: obligation (must do), prohibition (must not do), standard (principle-based), permission (may do).

anchor_ref.description: URI or semantic path linking directly to the Editorial Doctrine section (e.g., urn:doctrine:section:/principles/fairness).

evaluator_type.description: Defines the nature of the evaluator — who or what measures compliance.

message.description: Violation message template or judgment output.

applicability.description: Conditions under which this directive is applicable.

jurisdiction_refs.description: Array of jurisdiction labels this directive applies to.

trigger_conditions.description: Additional conditions that must be met for this directive to activate.

trigger_logic.description: Logical conditions under which this directive is active or skipped.

if_jurisdiction.description: Active if jurisdiction matches any of these.

if_state.description: Active if in this lifecycle state.

unless.description: Conditions under which this directive is skipped.

enforcement_weight.description: Legal/Operational severity detached from code severity. absolute_veto = zero tolerance; informative = best practice.

reasoning.description: Why this directive exists — the doctrinal rationale.

fix.description: Actionable fix suggestion or remediation path.

params.description: Unconstrained key-values. Accepts tax rates, regex, word counts, geopolitical zones, financial thresholds, or any domain-specific parameters.

semantic_tags.description: Keywords for semantic matching with the editorial prose (e.g., ['privacy', 'data-handling']).

interpretation.description: Guidance for applying judgment. Use with kind=standard.

factors.description: Relevant considerations when interpreting this standard.

examples.description: Illustrative scenarios showing how the standard applies.
